title: (authz) Centralize CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE enforcement for mutating dispatch
description: AUDIT (epic 6mij decomposition): enforcement today is per-handler and drift-prone. coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request (lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:45-89) FAILS OPEN: with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE undefined the whole OSCORE branch compiles out, is_protected=false, and every gate degrades to lichen_coap_is_local_admin alone; for the ungated handlers (rangetest coap_rangetest.c:729/765, slots coap_slot_coord.c:973) it provides nothing. Eleven handlers re-implement the same 'unprotect -> (is_protected || local_admin) -> respond via coap_oscore_respond_resource' sequence inline (coap_config.c:738+862, coap_dtn.c:112+236, coap_server.c:185+310, coap_waypoints.c:926+1069, coap_location.c:1293, checkin_resource.c:146+235+338, coap_msg.c:957+1116+1345+1751+1809+1939, coap_keys.c:246+409), and two drifted into no gate at all. FIX: one shared authorize helper at the dispatch boundary (a mutating-request gate that bundles unprotect + is_protected||local_admin + 4.01 respond + payload publication) and migrate ALL mutating handlers to it. COORDINATION: children worker6-giol/worker6-dsrv already track config_put (coap_server.c) migration and worker6-w1pp/worker6-fmee/worker6-h8b5/worker6-4hqw/worker6-dedy/worker6-2m4y/worker6-1vel track bugs in the coap_oscore_auth_mutating helper draft from 6mij.2.4 (not on main yet) - adopt/finish that helper rather than starting a third variant; reconcile those findings in this bead's implementation. Also document the fail-open semantics in Kconfig LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE help (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/Kconfig:81-93). ACCEPTANCE: (1) single helper owns the gate; zero inline re-implementations remain in the handlers listed above (grep-verified); (2) rangetest+slots fixes (worker6-16zc/worker6-wr8j/worker6-2hte) use it; (3) Kconfig help states: disabled = admin-only fallback, enabled = OSCORE verify by EUI64 ctx (coap_oscore.c:54-84) + admin fallback; (4) all existing per-resource tests still pass; (5) host CMake tests green.
